summary_en: Correction to prior cancellation notice dated 2026-08-07. Effective date adjusted from 2026-10-31 to 2026-10-30. Share count and percentage not re-stated in correction notice.
title_en: Correction Notice: Partial Correction to 'Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Shares'
translation_en_brief: Asahipen issued a correction notice on 2026-08-10 to its treasury share cancellation announcement of 2026-08-07. The sole correction was to the effective date of the cancellation: changed from 2026-10-31 to 2026-10-30. The original cancellation program details (share count, percentage of shares outstanding, and all substantive terms) remain unchanged from the prior notice and are not restated in this correction document.
